title: Rapid-fire notes & errand list — morning dump
content:
MORNING BRAIN DUMP — 2026-03-16

Top-of-mind tasks (short):
- Standup: mention retry/backoff experiment still flaky — include short repro steps.
- Merge PR #884 (quant-opt) after green CI. Quick check items: validate int8 quant table, run smoke on cpu32.
- Remind Elena about the rollout config doc (link in Slack).
- Ping infra for quota bump on dedicated test pool (needed for load test tomorrow).

Errands / Personal to-dos:
- Drop off dry cleaning on the way to office (open at 8:30).
- Pick up almond milk + lunch: get salad kit (no croutons) + extra napkins.
- Refill Metro card (online top-up) — check promo auto-credit.
- Dentist appointment: Tue 2026-03-24 15:00 — confirm insurance code.
- Renew passport application: start forms this weekend (photos required).

Work follow-ups / notes to self: 
- Small prompt test harness idea: script that runs 5 prompts across 3 model variants and records latency + top-3 tokens overlap. Put prototype under experiments/prompt-smoke.
- TODO: write short blurb for biz-dev about dedicated benefits (cost predictability + SLA) — 3 bullets.
- Ask Max to run a one-off evictions test for cache TTL changes.
- Track token-cost for test dataset A (sample 500) — create sheet and invite Elena.

Quick technical snippets to keep handy:
- Clear local python venv caches: rm -rf ~/.cache/pip ~/.cache/python-build
- Local docker prune (careful): docker system prune -f --volumes

Meeting prep (today):
- 10:00 Sync w/console team: discuss rollout UI for canary rules. Notes: prefer explicit traffic % + time window selector; show fallback model option.
- 14:00 Call w/Customer X: bring SLA doc, example latency profile, and cost estimate for 2M tokens/month.
- 16:30 1:1 with manager: 3 highlights (quant wins, infra quota, hiring ask).

Small experiments / ideas:
- Try trimming KV-cache by 25% for low-priority routes to see per-token cost delta.
- Run A/B of batching policy: aggressive vs conservative on same traffic slice. Metrics: P95 latency, cost/token.

Unresolved questions / reminders:
- Does dedicated autoscaler respect burst capacity if pinned? Confirm behavior. (Follow Jira RDW-4217)
- Is there a tenant-level cost cap we can present in sales deck? If not, propose feature.
- Add note to handbook about private deployment network checklist (KMS, firewall rules, cert rotation).

Inbox zero micro-actions:
- Archive Slack threads older than 30d not pinned.
- Reply to Olivia re: on-call doc by EOD.
- Send updated test plan to QA.

Random personal note:
- Try 'Bluebird' cafe next to 4th St — good coffee, quieter than usual spots.
- Pack charger+USB-C hub for trip to SF (Wed) — board 09:40.

End-of-day acceptance:
- 3 work items advanced (PR merged, infra pinged, meeting notes posted).
- 2 errands done (dry cleaning, lunch).
- Short retrospective: did I automate any repetitive small task? If not, pick one tomorrow.

---
Notes to self (fragments, unsorted):
- "short-circuit fallback" logic: on model error -> immediate fallback rather than retry loop unless specific transient codes.
- Save a copy of the latency heatmap (console) before doing batch policy change.
- Draft email to sales: include per-token estimate + sample SLA table (bronze/silver/gold).

DONE?: no — keep this live, prune items as done.
